test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A motorboat travels 120 kilometers upstream in 6 hours and covers the same distance of 120 kilometers downstream in 4 hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water? ?
solution:
Distance upstream = 120 km

Time upstream = 6 hour

Distance downstream = 120 km

Time downstream = 4 hours

Formula Used:

Speed = Distance / Time
